gen-amatic-sc-gf-biryani: Biryani lays down a plain sans body with big open e's and no stroke contrast, so it never clogs up. Amatic SC's quirky hand-drawn headings sit above it, and paragraphs below stay easy to follow.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-blinker: Blinker fills most of its height with lowercase and keeps open apertures, giving the text a sturdy, readable feel. Under Amatic SC's rustic, pen-drawn headings, Blinker carries long paragraphs without any strain.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-carrois-gothic: Spindly strokes that look squeezed from a tube in one line give Amatic SC its rustic, quirky voice. Carrois Gothic's high x-height lets you size the body modestly.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Amatic SC draws casual, pen-and-paper headings with no brush-like swelling in the stroke, and Carrois Gothic SC sits underneath. Its curves stay open and its capitals hug lowercase height, so a long page feels contemporary and approachable.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-cascadia-code: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC scribbles its headings in a single squeezed line with terminals drifting off the stem. And Cascadia Code answers with wire-thin strokes and generous spacing, a sans that makes the handmade-versus-engineered gap the pair's best quality.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-cascadia-mono: Rustic and quirky, Amatic SC writes its headings like casual pen marks, with terminals stopping well short of the stem. And Cascadia Mono lines its letters up like pins in a wide board, so a long page of this sans-serif reads modern and steady.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-chivo: Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the capitals and leaves visible daylight in every curve. Chivo's sturdy sans-serif frame is the pair's strongest quality, set against Amatic SC's headings that bend like thin steel rod.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-chocolate-classical-san: Hand-lettered charm meets broad-nibbed calm: Amatic SC's headings keep one unswelling line, and Chocolate Classical Sans backs it with a sizable lowercase. Its curves never curl shut, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-comme: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC draws its headings in a marker-like line. Amatic SC is best at casual personality, while Comme is best at a smooth, unclogged read, with lowercase filling most of each letter's height.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-cossette-texte: Scribbled charm up top, tidy text below. Amatic SC's single-line headings give way to Cossette Texte, whose wide-eyed e and prominent x-height keep a long page of this sans clear and unhurried.
